### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`checkm2/quality_report.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/checkm2/quality_report.py) | One row per metagenome-assembled genome, with CheckM2's verdict on it. | `bin_id`, `sample`, `assembler`, `binner`, `completeness`, `contamination`, `quality_score`, `quality_tier`, `coding_density`, `contig_n50`, `genome_size`, `gc_content`, `total_coding_sequences`, `total_contigs`, `max_contig_length`, `completeness_model` |
| [`gtdbtk/rank_composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/gtdbtk/rank_composition.py) | How many bins each binning run recovered per taxon, one row per rank. | `sample_id`, `sample`, `assembler`, `binner`, `rank`, `taxon`, `abundance` |
| [`gtdbtk/summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/gtdbtk/summary.py) | One row per classified bin, with its GTDB lineage split into ranks. | `bin_id`, `sample`, `assembler`, `binner`, `marker_set`, `domain`, `phylum`, `class_name`, `order`, `family`, `genus`, `species`, `rank_assigned`, `classification`, `closest_reference`, `closest_ani`, `closest_af`, `classification_method`, `msa_percent`, `bin_count` |
| [`mag/bin_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mag/bin_summary.py) | One row per bin, joining everything four tools know about it. | `bin_id`, `sample`, `assembler`, `binner`, `completeness`, `contamination`, `quality_score`, `quality_tier`, `mimag_tier`, `total_length`, `n_contigs`, `n50`, `gc_percent`, `cds`, `trna`, `rrna`, `cds_per_mbp`, `meets_mimag_rna`, `domain`, `phylum`, `class_name`, `order`, `family`, `genus`, `species`, `rank_assigned`, `classified`, `sources_present` |

| [`nf-core/mag/assembly_recruitment.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mag/recipes/assembly_recruitment.py) | Cross-sample read recruitment: one row per assembly, one column per read sample. | `assembly_id`, `assembler`, `sample` |

| [`nf-core/mag/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mag/recipes/samples.py) | One row per nf-core/mag sample, from the samplesheet the pipeline validated. | `sample_id`, `group`, `short_reads_platform`, `long_reads_platform`, `has_long_reads` |
